question: Should this owner-authored dependency refresh merge once the in-progress exact-head validation succeeds, including acceptance of the workspace-wide Hono override?
rationale: The compatibility and security-remediation tradeoff is intentional repository maintenance, and the PR is authored by the repository owner; automated cleanup must not substitute for that maintainer judgment.

options.title: Merge after validation
